# &lt;net/if.h&gt;

Source: [`src/libc/include/net/if.h`](https://github.com/lassedtu/ginnOS/blob/main/src/libc/include/net/if.h)

network interfaces: struct ifreq for the SIOC ioctls of
       &lt;sys/ioctl.h&gt;, which work on any AF\_INET socket.

the layout is Linux's; it must match kifreq\_t in
src/kernel/net/netif.h.
